Subject: Details needed for portal CNAME change

Hello Alex,

We can prepare the authorized CNAME change, but no change has been made. Could you please confirm the exact target FQDN, desired TTL or acceptable propagation behavior, and preferred maintenance window? After we receive those details, we will confirm final approval before scheduling. DNS propagation follows the agreed TTL; after the approved change we will verify the authoritative nameserver and a public resolver.

Once confirmed, we will provide the next scheduling step.
